items.stem: A liquidity provider in a constant-product pool sees the two asset prices diverge sharply. What is impermanent loss?

options.text: The value shortfall versus simply holding, caused by the pool rebalancing as prices move
options.rationale: Correct: rebalancing against price moves underperforms holding.

options.text: A fee charged by the protocol for withdrawing
options.rationale: It is not a withdrawal fee.

options.text: The gas cost of providing liquidity
A permanent loss that can never reverse
options.rationale: It can shrink if prices return.

items.explanation: Correct: rebalancing against price moves underperforms holding.

items.stem: Which TWO risks are specific to using DeFi lending protocols? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A sharp collateral price drop can trigger liquidation of the borrower's position
options.rationale: Correct: liquidation risk is core to collateralised lending.

options.text: A manipulated price oracle can cause unfair liquidations or bad debt
options.rationale: Correct: oracle risk directly affects lending protocols.

options.text: The borrower's bank can freeze the account
options.rationale: DeFi lending has no bank intermediary.

options.text: Interest can only ever be paid in fiat

items.explanation: Correct: liquidation risk is core to collateralised lending.

items.stem: Why is a single pool's spot price a dangerous oracle for a lending protocol?

options.text: A large trade can move it momentarily, letting an attacker borrow against a fake price
options.rationale: Correct: thin-pool spot prices are cheaply manipulated.

options.text: Spot prices are illegal to read on-chain
options.rationale: They are readable; the issue is manipulability.

items.explanation: Correct: thin-pool spot prices are cheaply manipulated.
